t: The only thing that will count
a: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
p: Wa lā tukhzinī yawma yubʿathūn, yawma lā yanfaʿu mālun wa lā banūn, illā man ata-llāha bi-qalbin salīm.
m: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected - The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
